title: Our Secret
desc: Genius high schooler Zhou Si Yue is loved by everyone — except his headstrong deskmate Ding Xian. Forced to share a desk for a year, their bickering slowly turns into a deep bond that spans from high school through university.
fanNote: If you loved Hidden Love's Chen Zheyuan, he's in this one too!

title: Hidden Love
desc: Sang Zhi has silently loved her older brother's best friend Duan Jiaxu since high school. A sweet, slow-burn secret crush story with a deeply satisfying payoff.
fanNote: One of the most beloved C-drama couples in recent years. Season 2 coming 2026!

title: Exclusive Fairytale
desc: A sweet childhood sweethearts story following Ling Chao and Xiao Tu from kindergarten through high school. High-IQ Ling Chao secretly loves his carefree neighbor but never admits it — classic slow burn.
fanNote: Stars Wen Junhui from SEVENTEEN — his acting will surprise you!

title: Always Home
desc: Four childhood friends navigate high school, college, love triangles, family struggles, and growing up together. Warm, emotional, and grounded in real-life moments.
fanNote: Keep tissues nearby for the later episodes — the emotions are very real.

title: 10 Years of Loving You
desc: A decade-long love story built on quiet moments, missed chances, growing pain, and the kind of loyalty that stays through every season of life.
fanNote: Best if you like soft, emotional stories about love that grows over time.

title: Time and Him Are Just Right
desc: A tender love story about meeting the right person at the right moment, when growing hearts, quiet timing, and mutual understanding finally fall into place.
fanNote: Perfect for when you want a gentle romance where fate feels soft instead of dramatic.

title: The Best Day of My Life
desc: A warm coming-of-age romance where one unforgettable day changes everything, turning ordinary moments into memories that stay bright for years.
fanNote: Best for fans of soft, nostalgic stories that make small moments feel life-changing.

title: Reset
desc: After a deadly bus explosion, two strangers get trapped in a time loop and must uncover the truth before the same disaster repeats again and again.
fanNote: One of the easiest thriller C-dramas to binge — tense, smart, and impossible to stop.

title: Under the Skin
desc: A gifted forensic sketch artist teams up with a police captain to solve disturbing crimes, using portraiture and observation to uncover what others miss.
fanNote: Perfect if you want crime-solving with brains, tension, and a fresh investigative hook.

title: The Bad Kids
desc: Three children accidentally witness a murder, setting off a chilling chain of manipulation, fear, and moral collapse.
fanNote: Go in ready for dread — this one is haunting, sharp, and emotionally unsettling.

title: The Long Night
desc: A public body-disposal case opens the door to a devastating truth buried under years of injustice, sacrifice, and silence.
fanNote: Heavy, brilliant, and deeply rewarding if you like thrillers with social weight.

title: Love Me If You Dare
desc: A brilliant criminal profiler and his assistant unravel violent cases while navigating a tense bond shaped by danger and obsession.
fanNote: A classic pick if you want thriller tension with a little romance mixed in.

title: A Murderous Affair in Horizon Tower
desc: A woman is found murdered in a luxury apartment tower, and each new testimony reveals another hidden layer of lies, class tension, and pain.
fanNote: Great for viewers who like a slow-burn mystery with shifting perspectives.

title: Be Reborn
desc: A university student with a suspicious family history gets pulled into a string of high-level art thefts and police investigations.
fanNote: A sleek thriller choice if you enjoy clever cases and suspicious characters.

title: Day and Night
desc: A former detective secretly swaps places with his twin brother to investigate a murder case while evading suspicion from the police.
fanNote: A must for thriller fans who love identity games and nonstop tension.

title: The Disappearing Child
desc: When a child vanishes from a stairwell without explanation, neighbors, parents, and buried truths begin to unravel in unnerving ways.
fanNote: A quieter thriller that builds unease scene by scene.

title: Burning Ice
desc: A brutal murder investigation pulls a sharp but flawed detective into a bleak web of violence, survival, and human desperation.
fanNote: For when you want something colder, darker, and more ruthless.

title: When We Were Young
desc: A group of high school friends grows up together in the 1990s, sharing laughter, crushes, and the complicated feeling of becoming adults.
fanNote: Very nostalgic if you love ensemble youth stories with a strong memory-locked vibe.

title: With You
desc: A shy student enters a new chapter of school life, builds lasting friendships, and slowly experiences the ache of first love and growing up.
fanNote: A very classic youth drama that captures the feeling of being young and unsure.

title: My Huckleberry Friends
desc: A bright girl enters high school, reconnects with old friends, and learns how friendship, ambition, and youth shape who she becomes.
fanNote: One of the most heartfelt nostalgic picks if you like soft school memories.

title: Skate Into Love
desc: Two childhood classmates meet again at university and reconnect through sports, rivalry, and the warmth of growing up together.
fanNote: A cheerful nostalgic watch with strong childhood-to-love energy.
